name: Insomnium
detailed_description:
When the lights go out, survival isn’t a solo act—it’s a team strategy. Will your group have what it takes to succeed, or will the nightmare consume you?

Insomnium is a high-stakes cooperative survival horror experience for up to four players. Each session presents a procedurally generated environment filled with increasingly dangerous threats and scarce resources. Every decision carries weight, and the risk of permanent loss keeps the stakes high throughout.

Success hinges on effective communication and teamwork.
Extract resources, avoid lethal encounters, and adapt to an environment where the tension escalates with every extraction.
Your ability to coordinate and execute under pressure directly impacts your team’s survival and progression.

Each player is given a single life per run.
If someone falls, revival is only possible through rare resources—or you may have to wait until the next round, provided any teammates endure.
As long as one team member survives and completes the extraction, your group continues to advance.

  • Procedurally Generated Environments
    Every mission is unique, with unpredictable layouts, enemy placements, and resource locations.

  • Escalating Difficulty
    The deeper your team ventures, the more formidable and numerous the threats become.

  • Character Progression & Customization
    Enhance abilities and adapt your strategy using in-game merchants and upgrades.

  • Resource Management
    Trade collected items in the commerce hub between missions, and make strategic decisions on inventory management during operations.

  • Reputation & Quest System
    Complete tasks for merchants to improve your standing, unlocking better prices and higher-grade equipment.

  • High-Risk Supply Drops
    Use special flares to call in supply vending machines, gaining access to advanced gear—but at the risk of attracting unwanted attention.

  • Team-Based Tactics
    Coordinate to distract threats, share supplies, or strategically split up to maximize coverage.
    Remember: improper coordination can quickly lead to failure.

  • Immersive Horror Atmosphere
    Meticulous audio and visual design create a pervasive sense of dread, keeping your team on edge from start to finish.

🕳️ Add Insomnium to your wishlist and get ready to face your fears—together. 🕳️

short_description: Insomnium is a cooperative extraction survival horror game where escaping the nightmare means more than just hiding. You’ll need to outsmart relentless entities, solve dynamic puzzles, and work as a team to gather resources and survive long enough to extrac before it's too late...
